subject: Re: Capacity check + temporary GPU hold for EdgeScale pilot
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@edgescale.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Lo <ben.lo@edgescale.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff: temporary GPU reservation request

Hi Vanessa,

We're excited to move forward with the pilot after last week's technical review. Our initial evaluation window is targeted to start the week of Jun 7 and run for ~6 weeks. Based on expected throughput, we anticipate needing a burst of capacity roughly equivalent to 8 A100s (40k token/min sustained) during the first three weeks, then a steady state of about 3 A100s after that.

Before we lock dates, procurement and our infra team asked whether Redwood can put a temporary soft-hold on that capacity for EdgeScale (no billing yet) while contracts are finalized. If a soft hold isn't possible, we'd appreciate a clear timeline for when capacity could be guaranteed so we can align our internal rollout.

Attached is a one-page pilot SOW (EdgeScale_SOW_draft_v1.pdf) with the approximate timing and success criteria. Please let me know what additional info your capacity team needs.

Thanks,
Alice

--
Alice Chen
Head of ML Infrastructure
EdgeScale Inc.
alice@edgescale.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice@edgescale.ai>
Cc: Ben Lo <ben.lo@edgescale.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: temporary GPU reservation request

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the SOW and timelines, this helps a lot. I’ve looped in Rishi (capacity planning) and Priyom (dedicated ops) to run an availability check and advise on whether we can do a soft hold for the Jun 7 start.

Quick asks for the planning team:
- Can you confirm peak sustained tokens/min and expected seq lengths for the first 3 weeks? (we'll map to slot sizing)
- Any hard constraint on start date flexibility (+/- 7 days)?
- Are you expecting other Geo preferences (we're defaulting US-west)?

We’ll try to get back with a short capacity summary and a recommended hold length within 48 hours. If we can place a temporary hold that blocks the GPUs from being reallocated but doesn't trigger billing, we’ll note the expiration and rollback policy.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll follow up once Rishi checks inventory.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0199
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@edgescale.ai>, Ben Lo <ben.lo@edgescale.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: temporary GPU reservation request

Vanessa / Priyom —

I completed an inventory and publishable summary (attached: capacity_estimate_20270517.xlsx). TL;DR: we can support the requested burst for the Jun 7 window in US-west with the following constraints and recommendations:

- Current available spare slots equivalent to 12 A100s for the Jun 7–21 window; after Jun 21 we can safely guarantee 4 A100s for steady state.
- To avoid impacting larger commitments we recommend a time-limited soft hold (no billing) of 10 x A100-equivalent slots from Jun 1–Jun 30. That gives EdgeScale runway for tuning and mitigates failure risk during the initial run.
- Soft hold behavior: slots are reserved but can be bumped only for higher-priority SLA-backed commitments; in bump events we will notify 48 hrs in advance and offer standby replacement capacity (cross-region if acceptable).
- Ops notes: if EdgeScale requires hard reservation (billed, contract-backed), we can convert to a dedicated reservation by Jun 1 with a 3-month minimum commit. Pricing delta estimates included in the spreadsheet.

Action items I need from Sales/Legal to put the soft hold in place:
1) Written confirmation of hold window and number of A100-equivalent slots (vanessa to confirm with customer).
2) Approval to set the internal hold flag and a note in the deal record (HubSpot link below).

I’ll standby to apply the hold once we have written confirmation from the customer.

-Rishi
Sr Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Ben Lo <ben.lo@edgescale.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@edgescale.ai>, procurement@edgescale.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: temporary GPU reservation request

Hi Vanessa / Rishi —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the capacity summary. EdgeScale is happy to confirm the soft hold request as follows:

- Request: 10 A100-equivalent slots (burst to 8 during peak)
- Window: Jun 1 00:00 UTC — Jun 30 23:59 UTC
- Geo: US-west preferred, cross-region fallback acceptable with 4 hrs notice
- Flexibility: start date can move +/- 5 days if absolutely required, but we plan to keep Jun 7 as target

Procurement (procurement@edgescale.ai) is copied; we’re aiming to finish contract redlines by May 28 and will provide signed SOW/DocuSign link as soon as available.

Please apply the soft hold and confirm the internal hold id so we can reference it in our procurement ticket.

Best,
Ben Lo
VP Product, EdgeScale
ben.lo@edgescale.ai
+1 (415) 555-0190
